how: No wholesale file copy. Merged expert-first-touch then ns-ledger onto main (deltanet-gqa2 + joint-token-ns already present).
OverlapMode dispatch stays in forward_token_device. Fuse/split remain reachable.
No-copy pack + remember_routes live in host_route_and_bind so every topology gets the first-touch win.
Prefetch (commit_no_wait + wait_idle) is only on the serial default path and is suppressed when the ns ledger is on, so production CB shape is unchanged for measurement.
Device maxBufferLength is read via objc, not the metal-rs 0.29 1 GiB helper.
Ledger v2 keeps gpu_start_ns/gpu_end_ns for the joint TOKEN_NS adapter and gpu_start_s/gpu_end_s for the compact receipt.
